paragraphs.text:
The cafe is a good place to hear rumors. You’ll hear snatches 
of conversation for every hour you spend here, but what you 
hear depends on how well you understand what was said. Roll 
1D10 for each hour you spend at the cafe, and modify the result 
as noted: increase the result by +1 for each 10 percentiles or 
fraction thereof of your Language (Arabic); increase the result 
by +2 if a native of Egypt is with you. Make a new roll each 
hour spent there:
• For a result of 1 or 2, go to 342.
• For a result of 3 or 4, go to 343.
• For a result of 5 or 6, go to 365.
• For a result of 7 or 8, go to 387.
• For a result of 9 or more, go to 363.
(134, 342, 343, 363, 365, 387)
